list.title: Landings
list.emptyDescription: Upload a ZIP landing or add an external URL to use it as the first step of a flow.

form.description: Uploaded landings are a ZIP with index.html (or index.twig) at the root plus its assets — tracking links and the click handler are injected automatically. External landings point at a URL you already host.

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters
validation.archiveNotZip: The file must be a .zip archive
validation.archiveTooLarge: The archive must be 50 MB or smaller

form.typeLocked: The type can't be changed after creation.
form.archiveChoose: Choose a .zip or drop it here
form.archiveHint: Up to 50 MB · index.html or index.twig at the root
form.archiveReplaceHint: Re-uploading keeps this landing's ID (flows stay attached) and replaces all of its files, including template edits.

rowActions.archiveConfirmDescription: Archived landings are hidden from flow pickers going forward. Existing flows that already reference this landing keep working. This can be reversed later.

requirements.title: Archive requirements
requirements.entry: index.html (or index.twig) must be at the root of the archive — or at the root of its single top-level folder.
requirements.links: Every <a> link gets the tracking URL and click handler — no tracking code needed in your HTML.
requirements.manualBind: For a non-link button, bind the handler yourself:
requirements.twig: In index.twig you can also use the macro
requirements.skip: To keep a link (e.g. a privacy policy) out of the flow, add
requirements.limits: Limits: 50 MB archive, 100 MB unpacked, 1000 files, 2 MB entry file.

editor.title: Edit template — {{name}}
editor.description: Changes preview live on the right, rendered exactly as visitors get it. Saving updates only the entry file; other files in the archive stay as uploaded.
editor.discardDescription: Your edits to the template haven't been saved.
